# SMALL HOURS

## Brand
- Category: adult embroidery starter kits
- Channel: own online shop
- Audience: adults beginning their first handwork project
- Brand wording: SMALL HOURS
- Tagline: Your first stitches, clearly guided
- Heading color: pine green #264C43
- Information-panel color: cream #F5F0E6
- Background: warm white; product image wells: white

## Range
| SKU | Name | Individual price | Motif | Motif area |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EK-01 | Fern Study | USD 24 | One stem, 12 leaves in six pairs | 100 × 100 mm |
| EK-02 | Daisy Study | USD 24 | Three flowers, eight petals per flower | 100 × 100 mm |

## Contents per kit
| Item | Quantity | Specification |
|---|---|---|
| Wooden embroidery hoop | 1 | Inner diameter 150 mm; outer diameter 166 mm; brass screw at top |
| Preprinted cotton square | 1 | 250 × 250 mm; natural cream; SKU-specific motif |
| Cotton skeins | 4 | One per color; 8 m per skein; six strands |
| Embroidery needles | 2 | No. 7; length 38 mm |
| Stitch guide | 1 | 100 × 140 mm; portrait; shared four-stage guide |
| Kraft box | 1 | 270 × 270 × 35 mm |

## Shared thread palette
| Code | Name | Color |
|---|---|---|
| T01 | Pine | #365744 |
| T02 | Sage | #90A889 |
| T03 | Cream | #F3E9D2 |
| T04 | Ochre | #C99236 |

## Purchase wording
| Group | Exact wording | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| Supplied goods | In your kit | Hoop, preprinted fabric, four skeins, two needles, guide, box |
| Buyer-supplied tool | You supply: scissors | Scissors |
| Project outcome | Finished example - stitch it yourself | Completed embroidery |

## Guide sequence
1. Mount the fabric
2. Separate two strands and thread the needle
3. Stitch the motif
4. Finish the back

## Shopping-image geometry
- Main image proportion: 1:1
- Detail panel proportion: 2:3
- Shopping card proportion: 9:16
- Information band: upper 20% of image height
- Product image well: lower 80% of image height
- Outer content margins: 5% of image width and height
- Minimum text height: 3% of the image's shorter side
- Main-image product group width: 85–90% of the image well's width
- Typography location: information band
- Product well content: product and material imagery on white

## Component appearance
- Hoop: pale wood, circular nested rings, brass screw at top
- Fabric: natural cream cotton with fine gray printed outlines
- Skeins: four separate colors, plain cream paper wraps
- Needles: silver-colored metal, elongated eyes, pointed tips
- Guide: white rectangular card, four black line-drawing stages
- Box: plain kraft shallow square box with lift-off lid

## Record source
- Stock, stitches and project stages: 03-kit-records.en.md

steps.userMessage:
SMALL HOURS | Adult embroidery starter kit product visuals

We sell embroidery kits to adults starting their first handwork project. Build the product visuals for our own online shop around a warm white background, pine green #264C43 headings and cream #F5F0E6 information panels. Print "SMALL HOURS" and "Your first stitches, clearly guided" on the main images and vertical shopping cards. Our two individually sold kits are Fern Study, EK-01, USD 24, and Daisy Study, EK-02, USD 24. Fern Study has one stem with 12 leaves in six pairs; Daisy Study has three flowers with eight petals each. Each motif occupies 100 × 100 mm.

Each kit contains one wooden hoop with a 150 mm inner diameter and 166 mm outer diameter, one 250 × 250 mm preprinted cotton square, four 8 m skeins of six-strand cotton, two No. 7 embroidery needles measuring 38 mm, one 100 × 140 mm stitch guide and one 270 × 270 × 35 mm kraft box. Both kits use T01 Pine #365744, T02 Sage #90A889, T03 Cream #F3E9D2 and T04 Ochre #C99236. The guide follows four stages: mount the fabric, separate two strands and thread the needle, stitch the motif, finish the back. Label the supplied materials "In your kit", scissors "You supply: scissors", and completed work "Finished example - stitch it yourself". The finished embroidery is the project outcome. Use square main images, portrait detail panels and vertical shopping cards; place the main-image product group at 85–90% of the white image well's width. The attached layout diagram fixes the information band, margins and text scale.

Audience: adults choosing their first embroidery project, with the shop team using the work to approve product-page content and purchase clarity.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the product facts, brand colors and fixed wording. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-kit-records.en.md records stock quantities, thread assignments and project states. shop-layout-constraint.png defines the shopping-image geometry. kit-dimensions-constraint.png provides component quantities and dimensions, including the guide as a scale reference. hoop-identity.png records the shared wooden hoop. fern-fabric-identity.png records the preprinted Fern Study fabric. daisy-fabric-identity.png records the preprinted Daisy Study fabric. threads-identity.png records the four shared thread colors. needles-identity.png records the supplied needle pair. guide-identity.png records the shared stitch guide. box-identity.png records the kraft box. fern-finished-identity.png records the completed Fern Study motif. daisy-finished-identity.png records the completed Daisy Study motif. worktable-reference.png provides the atmosphere of an ordinary home craft table.

Deliverables:
1. Three specification documents: a one-page selling-points and information-hierarchy table with priorities, placements and minimum text sizes, a shot list assigning every final image and video its role, proportion and required content, and a two-SKU variant table with names, codes, dimensions, motif differences, thread assignments and individual prices
2. Two square main images, one per kit, with the kit, brand, tagline, SKU and price
3. Two inventory and dimensions panels, one per kit, with every supplied item and the stitch guide as a scale reference
4. Two four-stage instruction panels, one per kit, with the two-strand preparation detail
5. Two finished-example panels, one per kit, with the complete motif and outcome label
6. Two material-detail panels, one per kit, with the cotton weave, needle pair and four thread records
7. Two vertical shopping comparison cards covering both kits, one organized by motif and one by supplied materials, each with SKU codes, individual prices, brand and tagline
8. One purchase-contents panel covering both kits, with supplied materials, buyer-supplied scissors and completed-project examples in three labeled groups
9. Two stitch close-up panels, one per kit, with stem stitch, satin stitch and straight stitch identified
10. Two tabletop application images, one per kit, arranged for starting work
11. Two state-comparison panels, one per kit, with the preprinted, partly stitched and completed motif
12. One 10-second product explanation video covering both kits, their shared contents, two-strand preparation and completed outcomes
13. One presentation document of at least ten pages reusing the specifications and final visuals, with a page mapping the fixed facts to their images

Acceptance:
- The three specification documents come first and record #264C43, the 150 mm inner hoop diameter and the three purchase-status labels; both main images use that heading color, both inventory panels repeat that diameter, and the purchase-contents panel repeats those labels exactly.
- Both main images and both vertical comparison cards print SMALL HOURS, the tagline and their applicable SKU names, codes and USD 24 prices; all 19 final images follow their shot-list roles and the attached layout geometry, including the main images' 85–90% product-width range.
- Both inventory and material-detail panels account for every supplied quantity, component dimension and T01–T04 thread record; each inventory panel renders the hoop, fabric and guide at one proportional scale, and each tabletop image preserves those relative sizes.
- Both instruction panels follow the four stages with two working strands, and both stitch close-ups match the recorded stitch assignments; the state-comparison panels show Fern Study with six then 12 filled leaves and Daisy Study with one then three completed flowers.
- Both finished-example panels, both comparison cards and the purchase-contents panel use the exact outcome label; both instruction panels and tabletop images label scissors with the exact supply wording, and the purchase-contents panel places the complete stock list under the kit label.
- The 10-second video identifies both SKU records and prices and labels both completed outcomes; the presentation has at least ten pages, reuses all three specification documents and all 19 final images, includes three video stills, and maps the brand colors, quantities, dimensions, wording and SKU differences to named visuals.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
